correctness.rationale: The well-established free two-generator orthomodular lattice is F2≅MO2×2^4 (six times 16 =96 elements); freeness makes every pair (u,v) define a unique endomorphism and its image equal the generated subalgebra. Inspected actual verify.py and separately wrote/ran independent closure enumeration across all 96²=9,216 pairs, recomputing meet, join and orthocomplement and iterating to an exact finite fixed point; rank profile reproduced 2:4,4:564,8:3720,12:32,16:2880,24:672,48:1152,96:192. The center is 2^5; one central atom has a 6-element interval, hence is fixed, while the four Boolean atoms permute by S4; MO2 middle pair-preserving automorphisms form C2≀S2≅D8. Aut(F2)=D8×S4 has 192 maps, consistent with surjective endomorphism count. Its orbits are 3 MO2-types times five Boolean Hamming weights (15 total); 192 generating ordered pairs all have distinct entries and yield 96 unordered pairs. No generic/infinite extrapolation from enumeration is claimed.
